metadata.summary: Harry Kane is set to become England's most-capped player ever on Thursday night - will it also be time to crown him the country's greatest?
metadata.content: Harry Kane: Ballon d'Or winner set for Wembley celebration of England record | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Harry Kane: Ballon d'Or winner set for Wembley celebration of England record England captain Harry Kane set to win record-breaking 126th England cap in Nations League this week; Kane was voted England's greatest in a Sky Sports poll - but biggest prize still awaits; follow England vs Croatia with the Sky Sports website and app on Thursday; kick-off 7.45pm Peter Smith Senior Football Journalist @psmithXI Tuesday 10 November 2026 17:05, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports News' senior reporter Rob Dorsett analyses whether Harry Kane can now be considered England's greatest ever player. Harry Kane is set to become England's most-capped player ever on Thursday night - will it also be time to crown him the country's greatest? Kane's Ballon d'Or triumph last month coronated him as the world's best for the past year. Whether he should have the all-time No 1 spot for his country makes for a fascinating debate - not least with the weight of a World Cup win on the side of historic icons such as Bobby Charlton (another Ballon d'Or winner) and Bobby Moore (another captain fantastic). But, minus the big team triumph, Kane's individual case is compelling. messages.text: Vowles: Williams got carried away with success but 2026 only a blip

metadata.summary: Williams team principal James Vowles has admitted his squad "got carried away" with their success last season but insists a disappointing 2026 campaign is merely "a blip".
metadata.content: James Vowles: Williams boss admits team got carried away with success but says 2026 F1 season struggles are only 'a blip' | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content James Vowles: Williams boss admits team got carried away with success but says 2026 F1 season struggles are only 'a blip' Watch or listen to the latest episode of The Fast and the Curious to hear Williams boss James Vowles discuss the team's 2026 struggles, why he is confident a corner has been turned, and the changes he wants to see made to F1's cost cap rules Tuesday 10 November 2026 19:46, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Joining Christian Hewgil on the Fast and the Curious podcast, Williams Team Principal James Vowles responds to comments on the pressure of his position. Williams team principal James Vowles has admitted his squad "got carried away" with their success last season but insists a disappointing 2026 campaign is merely "a blip". Vowles took charge of Williams after joining from Mercedes at the start of 2023 and appeared to be having a hugely positive impact when the team finished fifth in the 2025 constructors' standings, which was their best finish since 2017. However, the biggest regulation change in the sport's history, which saw the introduction of both new power units and chassis, has seen Williams regress, leaving drivers Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon hugely frustrated. messages.text: Reynolds: Fearless Love can lead Packers to Super Bowl

metadata.summary: I'm well aware that we've only reached the halfway point of the 2026 season and so much can change in the NFL, especially at the back end of the year.
metadata.content: Jordan Love: Green Bay Packers quarterback is fearless and can lead Matt LaFleur's team to Super Bowl, says Neil Reynolds | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Jordan Love: Green Bay Packers quarterback is fearless and can lead Matt LaFleur's team to Super Bowl, says Neil Reynolds Sky Sports NFL's Neil Reynolds hails the form of Jordan Love and the Green Bay Packers in his weekly column; the Packers improved to 6-3 on the year on Sunday with a dominant win over the New England Patriots to continue their march towards the NFL playoffs Neil Reynolds American Football Expert & Columnist Tuesday 10 November 2026 15:33, UK I'm well aware that we've only reached the halfway point of the 2026 season and so much can change in the NFL, especially at the back end of the year. But I'm now starting to believe the Green Bay Packers can make a serious run and they have emerged as true contenders in the NFC. Sunday's 45-27 win over the New England Patriots in Foxborough was a statement victory and it was a win that showed the Packers to be a complete team. Jordan Love is playing as well as any quarterback in the NFL this season and he backed it up on Sunday on a big stage in a game being called by Tom Brady as he threw for 372 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions. metadata.summary: This year's edition of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos served up its usual fascinating challenges and surprises. The race was great, perhaps only missing a late surprise or crescendo.
metadata.content: Sao Paulo GP: Martin Brundle's verdict as Mercedes seal 2026 F1 constructors' title and Lando Norris wins wet race in Brazil | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Opinion Sao Paulo GP: Martin Brundle's verdict as Mercedes seal 2026 F1 constructors' title and Lando Norris wins wet race in Brazil Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle gives his verdict as Lando Norris triumphs on wet weekend at Sao Paulo Grand Prix and Mercedes seal the 2026 Constructors' Championship Tuesday 10 November 2026 15:54, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix This year's edition of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos served up its usual fascinating challenges and surprises. The race was great, perhaps only missing a late surprise or crescendo. I must first congratulate the whole Mercedes Benz team, car and power unit combined, for once again winning the Constructors' Championship for a ninth time as a team. A tally which draws team boss Toto Wolff level with Sir Frank Willams as the most in F1 history, and with a further eight Mercedes drivers' titles on his watch, equalling Sir Ron Dennis' combined total of 17 as team principal.
